Follow the workflow in [.claude/commands/assess.md](../../.claude/commands/assess.md) exactly.

- `$ARGUMENTS` in that file means: ${input:args:Arguments for /assess}

- Skills referenced by name are in `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
